outcome: rates of self-reported birth by caesarean section
cohort: 34,063 women from 384,549 households in Southern Tanzania who gave birth in the year prior to the survey
finding: Although use of caesarean section remains insufficient, analysis of data from Southern Tanzania between 2007 and 2013 highlights improvements in reaching women with caesarean section.
mod_finding: Although use of caesarean section remains insufficient, analysis of data from Southern Tanzania between 2007 and 2013 highlights improvements in reaching women with caesarean section.
